ministry.officialName: Ministry of Finance, Government of India

implementingAgency.officialName: Member Lending Institutions (Commercial Banks, RRBs, SFBs, MFIs, NBFCs) / MUDRA SIDBI

financialAssistance.loanCategories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh), Tarun Plus (₹10 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh)

targetBeneficiary.value: Any Indian citizen with a business plan for a non-farm income generating micro-enterprise in manufacturing, trading, or service sector

enterpriseTypes.value: Sole proprietorships, partnerships, small manufacturing units, service sector units, shopkeepers, artisans, and micro businesses

loanCategories.value: Credit requirement up to ₹20 Lakh across Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, and Tarun Plus categories

creditHistory.value: Applicant must not be a defaulter to any bank or financial institution and must have a satisfactory credit record

noCollateral.value: Collateral-free credit support without third-party guarantee

documents: Proof of Identity (Self-attested Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card, Passport, or Driving License)
Proof of Residence (Recent utility bill, Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or Bank Statement)
2 recent passport-size photographs of the applicant / partners / directors
Proof of Business Identity and Address (Business registration certificate, Udyam registration, or trade license)
Financial & Bank Documents (Bank statement for last 6 months, equipment quotations, and business proposal for Kishore, Tarun & Tarun Plus)

applicationProcess.type: Online / Offline via Member Lending Institutions
steps: Select loan category (Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, Tarun Plus)
Fill application form online via Member Lending Institution portals or offline at commercial bank branches
Submit business plan and required documents
